description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for a camera scanning screen with overlay, controls, and navigation logic. It includes UI components such as a mock camera preview, animated scan line, flash toggle, capture button, and gallery access, along with methods for user interactions and navigation to a steps screen with a stub payload.

classes.name: ScanScreen
classes.description: Main widget representing the camera scan interface.

classes.name: _ScanScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the animated scan line, flash toggle, capture process, and UI state.

classes.name: _RoundIconButton
classes.description: Custom widget for round icon buttons with tooltips.

classes.name: _ShutterButton
classes.description: Custom widget for the capture (shutter) button.

classes.name: _CornersOverlay
classes.description: Widget for drawing corner overlays on the camera preview.

classes.name: _CornerPainter
classes.description: Custom painter for drawing corner lines.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the animation controller and sets it to repeat, driving the animated scan line.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the animation controller to free resources.

methods.name: _toggleFlash
methods.description: Toggles the flash on/off state and shows a snackbar notification.

methods.name: _openGallery
methods.description: Handles gallery button press, currently shows a placeholder snackbar.

methods.name: _capture
methods.description: Simulates capturing an image, displays a processing snackbar, then navigates to a steps screen with a stub payload.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the camera overlay UI, including preview, animated scan line, corner overlays, and control bar.
